title: EduGuardBench: A Holistic Benchmark for Evaluating the Pedagogical Fidelity and Adversarial Safety of LLMs as Simulated Teachers
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the ethical and professional alignment of LLMs in educational roles. It specifically benchmarks ethical flaws such as academic misconduct, offensiveness (including prejudice), and indolence, and includes metrics for 'Educational Refusal' based on explaining ethical principles and risks.
